title: NSSSTA Advanced Masterclass in Survey Sampling & Master Frame Design
description: Specialized NSSSTA academy course on multi-stage stratified random sampling, urban/rural block frame updating, and sampling weight calibration.

title: NSSSTA Workshop on System of National Accounts (SNA 2008 / 2025)
description: In-depth academy module covering Gross Domestic Product, Gross Value Added by economic activity, sequence of accounts, and base year revisions.

title: NSSSTA Field Operations Leadership & Microdata Quality Auditing
description: Comprehensive training for senior field officers on enumerator monitoring, spot-check protocols, re-interview statistics, and data quality assurance.

title: NSSSTA Special Course on Index Numbers Compilation (CPI, WPI & IIP)
description: Practical academy laboratory on item weighting, Laspeyres index formulas, geometric mean price aggregation, and seasonal adjustments.

title: NSSSTA Household Consumer Expenditure Survey (HCES) Methodology
description: Detailed examination of consumption item schedules, reference periods (MMRP vs URP), food/non-food weighting, and poverty line estimations.

title: NSSSTA Small Area Estimation (SAE) & Model-Based Inference
description: Advanced statistical techniques for combining survey sample data with administrative census records to produce district-level statistical estimates.

title: NSSSTA Training on Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) Frame & Schedules
description: Academy course covering factory registration frames, enterprise account balance sheet analysis, capital output ratios, and industrial tabulations.

title: NSSSTA Data Quality Assurance Framework (NQAF) Implementation
description: Institutional training on national quality guidelines, measuring sampling/non-sampling error, and executing pre-release statistical audits.

title: NSSSTA Micro-data Cleaning, Editing & Hot-Deck Imputation in R
description: Hands-on computing lab focusing on logical validation checks, outlier removal algorithms, and nearest-neighbor imputation models.

title: NSSSTA GIS & Remote Sensing Applications in Agricultural Surveys
description: Integrating satellite imagery (NDVI), GIS layer boundaries, and crop-cutting experiments for accurate agricultural crop statistics.

title: NSSSTA Demography, Population Censuses & Life Table Construction
description: Methods of mortality modeling, fertility rate estimation, age-sex pyramid analysis, and inter-censal population projections.

title: NSSSTA Executive Leadership in Statistical Governance & Capacity
description: High-level strategic training for senior leadership on statistical coordination across ministries, institutional reform, and staff capacity building.

title: NSSSTA Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Estimation Frameworks
description: In-depth academy module covering sample weighting for quarterly urban panels and annual rural/urban labor force indicators.

title: NSSSTA Statistical Data Visualization & Policy Dissemination
description: Effective visual design of national statistical publications, charts, and public policy briefs for non-statistical audience engagement.

title: NSSSTA Time Series Analysis & Seasonal Adjustment of Economic Indicators
description: Practical application of X-13ARIMA-SEATS software and R packages to seasonally adjust monthly trade and industrial production statistics.

title: NSSSTA Field Logistics, Budgeting & Risk Control in District Operations
description: Operational workshop on managing field travel budgets, vehicle deployment, enumerator honorariums, and emergency field contingencies.

title: NSSSTA Official Statistics Confidentiality & Differential Privacy Lab
description: Interactive laboratory on evaluating re-identification risks in survey microdata files and implementing statistical disclosure control.

title: NSSSTA Survey Questionnaire Design & Pre-Testing Protocols
description: Methodology for constructing unbiased question phrasing, field pre-testing, cognitive interviewing, and skip-pattern logic validation.

title: NSSSTA Automated Anomaly Detection for Administrative Registries
description: Applying data mining and machine learning to identify inconsistent records and duplicate entries in large civil registration databases.

title: NSSSTA SDMX Standard Data Modeling & Web Service Integration
description: Constructing SDMX Data Structure Definitions (DSD) and deploying automated REST web services for national statistical dissemination.
